C01.title: blob.reproducibility 篡改提升训练准入
C01.mechanism: Fail-closed under v2 (False); requires admission_bindings in v2.1 context

C02.title: entry/blob 许可篡改提升训练准入
C02.mechanism: Disk license cannot escalate admission; v2 context strictly returns False; v2.1 reports mismatch in store_problems

C03.title: 同 entry_id 不同内容静默覆盖
C03.mechanism: ImmutableConflictError raised on conflicting entry write

C04.title: write_blob 产物不通过契约 schema
C04.mechanism: Blob record formatted as output.files[].sha256 matching teacher_cache.v2.schema.json

C05.title: 条目 derivation 换模型后写入/读取放行
C05.mechanism: Derivation teacher/weights mismatch detected and rejected with HashMismatchError

C06.title: blob.key_material 被换模型后读路径不核验
C06.mechanism: read_blob recomputes sha(key_material), detects mismatch, marks .broken and raises HashMismatchError

C07.title: 契约合法内容块被实现误判 broken
C07.mechanism: T2 r2 uses output.files[].sha256 identical to schema, correctly reading contract-valid blobs

C08.title: Train Mode 下常驻教师句柄仍可产出
C08.mechanism: Generation incremented on release and mode switch; extract() raises ModeViolationError

C09.title: World Mode TTL 过期后句柄不失效
C09.mechanism: TTL expiration triggers release_teacher() on extract(), raising ModeViolationError

C10.title: 模式切换无内存回落检查 unload_incomplete
C10.mechanism: UnloadIncompleteError raised when RSS drop is insufficient

C11.title: 并发同键不同输出丢失 nondeterministic 拒绝
C11.mechanism: Whole-cache flock write lock + O_EXCL ensures at most one output is accepted across Barrier rounds

C12.title: 并发同键跨分区写入 TOCTOU
C12.mechanism: Whole-cache flock write lock + cross_partition check ensures cross-partition writes are rejected
